item.title: Fraud, affordability and Trump policies drive friction in Minnesota Senate debate
item.description: The major party candidates for Minnesota's U.S. Senate seat faced off in an hourlong debate Friday on MPR News with fraud, affordability and fallout from the Trump administration's policies as key points of friction.
item.content:encoded: The major party candidates for Minnesota's U.S. Senate seat faced off in an hourlong debate Friday on MPR News with fraud, affordability and fallout from the Trump administration's policies as key points of friction.

item.title: Week in Politics: Trump's Russian diesel deal update; why the DOJ is suing California
item.description: We look at where things are in the deal President Trump says he made to import Russian diesel, plus the reason why the Justice Department is suing California.

item.title: Katie Zacharia is out as press secretary, White House says
item.description: Katie Zacharia is "transitioning out" of her role as press secretary, according to a White House official not authorized to speak on the record, marking a stunning turn of events for the spokeswoman.

item.title: Do Americans own the president's papers? Appeals court to weigh in
item.description: The administration says papers created in the White House belong to Donald Trump, not to the American people. The case could ultimately end up at the conservative-leaning Supreme Court.

item.title: 'Everything got worse': Gen Z express frustration, regret after Trump vote
item.description: A focus group of eight Gen Z Trump voters reported feeling unhappy or disappointed with the state of politics, with some going as far as to say they regret supporting him in 2024.
